title: Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve Replacement (TTVR)

criteria.text: Furnished according to an FDA market-authorized indication
criteria.span: TTVR is covered when furnished according to a Food and Drug Administration (FDA) market-authorized indication

criteria.text: Symptomatic TR despite optimal medical therapy
criteria.span: Despite optimal medical therapy (OMT), patients must have symptomatic TR

criteria.text: Heart team considers tricuspid valve replacement appropriate
criteria.span: with tricuspid valve replacement being considered as appropriate by a heart team

criteria.text: Pre- and post-op heart team with at least a cardiac surgeon, interventional cardiologist, HF cardiologist, electrophysiologist, multi-modality imaging specialists and interventional echocardiographer
criteria.span: The patient (preoperatively and postoperatively) is under the care of a heart team, which includes, at minimum, the following

criteria.text: All listed specialists have experience in the care and treatment of TR
criteria.span: All of the specialists listed above must have experience in the care and treatment of TR.

criteria.text: Furnished in a CMS-approved CED study; not covered outside one
criteria.span: Transcatheter tricuspid valve replacement (TTVR) is not covered for patients outside of a CMS approved study.

notes: CED study-design criteria (B.3) are study-level and not tested. The NCD gives no anatomic or severity thresholds; cases state the heart team's judgment explicitly. Unlike NCD 20.38 (T-TEER), the TTVR heart team must include an electrophysiologist and multi-modality imaging specialists.
